Committee: Banking and Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25 as introduced could increase receipts to the Insurance Department Fund by and undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of expenses incurred by the Commissioner of Insurance to conduct examinations on warrantors of vehicle protection products.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance

Committee: Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25 as passed the Senate would reduce receipts to the State General Fund, and correspondingly increase receipts to the Insurance Department Fund, by $250 for each vehicle protection product registration fee received by the Department.
Kerry Rich, Chair
Insurance
